newsitem.title: UK: UK gilt repo mkt quiet ahead of monetary meeting.
newsitem.headline: UK gilt repo mkt quiet ahead of monetary meeting.

text.p: The UK gilt repo market had a quiet session as traders awaited Wednesday's monetary meeting, with attention focussing on two specials -- the 6.75 percent of 2004 and the 7.0 percent gilt due 2001.
* 6.75 percent of 2004 traded at around 4-1/2 percent.
* Some interest in three-month GC reported at around 6.18 percent.
* Traders said market sentiment was that monetary meeting could go either way but on balance, expectation is for official rates to remain unchanged at 6.0 percent.

* "The market seems to be erring on the side of caution and people seem less and inclined to believe there will be a rate increase," one trader said. "10 days ago I dealt three months cash at 6-1/2 percent, today it was 6-5/16."
* The Bank of England provided assistance totalling 714 million stg after forecasting a liquidity shortage of around 900 million.
